name: Pydantic AI
description: Type-safe Python agent framework that validates LLM output with Pydantic.
descriptionZh: 类型安全的 Python Agent 框架，用 Pydantic 校验 LLM 输出。
keyFact: Pydantic AI is an MIT-licensed Python agent framework from the Pydantic team that validates model output against Pydantic models and can automatically retry when validation fails, bringing the library's type-safety guarantees to agent structured output.
keyFactZh: Pydantic AI 是 Pydantic 团队以 MIT 许可开源的 Python Agent 框架，会用 Pydantic 模型校验模型输出，并在校验失败时自动重试，把该库的类型安全保证带入 Agent 的结构化输出。
